title: Rava bar Mari
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 86a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.86a.2); Hyman says the reading should be Rabbah bar Mari, as in Ein Yaakov.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Rava bar Mari. [Heilprin’s Rabbah bar Mari entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3170&lang=en) cites this passage with Rava in its body. Hyman attributes Rabbah to Ein Yaakov and argues for that reading.
